verdict.rationale: Codex is built specifically around OpenAI's own GPT-5.x-codex model family (e.g., gpt-5.3-codex, gpt-5.3-codex-spark referenced in community threads), with no evidence of an ability to switch to third-party providers like Anthropic or Google within a Codex session. All docs and comparisons treat other providers (Claude, Gemini) as separate competing products users switch away to, not as selectable options inside Codex.
